plan.stopping: Fixed trial list; no adaptive extension. Exhausted cumulative budget records remaining trials as not_run and yields partial. Each fit, inference, wall and RSS budget failure is retained as a failed trial
plan.selection_rule: Stage selections use macro MAE on tuning folds only. Feature set per algorithm: mean of both targets; within 0.25% of the best the fewest columns wins, then lexical. Preprocess: adopted only if it improves by >0.25%. Parameters per target: lowest macro MAE; the bounded configuration is kept unless beaten by >0.25%. Any failed fold excludes the variant. No second search round
plan.decision_rule: Per target, on the four holdout folds only: a variant is a research candidate if in cohort64 AND cohort128 it wins the majority of folds against Seasonal Naive, has no >20% key-segment degradation (n>=100, including peak_hour and stations 6753.08, 6230.02), valid resources and no warnings, and its family-wise paired macro MAE interval against Seasonal Naive is below zero; lowest cohort64 macro MAE among those, lexical tie; otherwise seasonal_naive. cohort256 is a sensitivity report and cannot create a candidate
plan.primary_metric: macro MAE over the same folds per target and population

H1_cyclic.claim: Bounded annual harmonics C cannot run off the training range
H1_cyclic.expect: LightGBM+C is not worse than LightGBM+A on the Dec fold; C gives no material gain over base on holdout
H1_cyclic.check: S1 fold T2 delta, S4 holdout ablation

H2_profile.claim: Variability and shape P describe low/high demand stations
H2_profile.expect: P lowers MAE on history:thin and band:0, not necessarily overall
H2_profile.check: paired P vs base inside the segments, S4 ablation

H3_shrinkage.claim: Pooling S protects stations with few cell labels
H3_shrinkage.expect: S lowers activity:new and history:thin MAE against base

H4_season_level.claim: Year-ago seasonality carries the level that delayed labels lose
H4_season_level.expect: Once season_index exists (holdout folds), bias magnitude falls
H4_season_level.check: holdout fold bias, season_index missing share

H5_hurdle.claim: Separate occurrence and intensity suit zero-heavy hours
H5_hurdle.expect: Hurdle beats single-stage LightGBM on activity:low and actual:zero, not on overall macro MAE

H6_preprocess.claim: Training exclusions of suspect rows barely change fits
H6_preprocess.check: S1 __pre variants on identical evaluation rows

H7_tuning.claim: Bounded search is not the main lever
H7_tuning.expect: Below 2% holdout macro MAE gain against the bounded configuration
H7_tuning.check: S3 selected vs bounded configuration with the same features

H8_year_over_year.claim: With the same calendar month in train, segment degradations shrink
H8_year_over_year.expect: H2/H3 folds (Apr, Jul 2026) have fewer gate degradations than H0/H1

evaluation_weather.use: Key-segment gate and diagnostics AFTER prediction; not a feature

uncertainty.method: crossed station x NY target-day pigeonhole bootstrap, paired weights, macro-fold estimand
uncertainty.familywise: Bonferroni over candidate x target x cohort64/128 against Seasonal Naive, plus Holm on bootstrap sign p-values
uncertainty.fold_level: exact sign-flip test on fold differences; 4 folds cannot reach p<0.125, reported only

plan.provenance: Tuning folds T0-T3 were scored by F4 and both later studies; their trials are not new evidence. Holdout folds H0-H3 were never scored by any model in this repository, but they lie inside the F2 EDA period and inside the training data of the frozen final models, and the hypotheses were written after reading prior results. They are unseen validation windows, not an independent test.
plan.test_policy: September 2026 already consumed, unused here. No new independent period exists; no promotion, no operational claim

1_trends.user_decision: Руководитель: как меняется активность и где ломается сопоставимость
1_trends.definition: METRICS §2 completed_published_rides, departures_s, arrivals_s, net_trip_flow_s; §4 изменение периода
1_trends.grain: NY month; hour exposure from trip_hourly

sql.monthly:
SELECT strftime(local_month,'%Y-%m') AS "month",
        sum(n)::BIGINT completed_published_rides,
        sum(departures)::BIGINT departures,sum(arrivals)::BIGINT arrivals,
        sum(arrivals)::BIGINT-sum(departures)::BIGINT net_trip_flow,
        sum(n)::BIGINT-sum(departures)::BIGINT unknown_start_rides,
        sum(arrival_rows)::BIGINT-sum(arrivals)::BIGINT unknown_end_rides,
        sum(arrival_rows)::BIGINT ended_rides
        FROM trip_monthly WHERE local_month>=DATE '2024-10-01' AND local_month<DATE '2026-10-01'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
sql.exposure:
SELECT strftime(lt,'%Y-%m') AS "month",
        count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0) observed_source_hours
        FROM hourly GROUP BY 1

1_trends.limits: Net trip flow sums known station IDs only, so its city total reflects month-edge trips and unknown IDs; it is not inventory. A ride change is not revenue. Year-over-year is shown both raw and per observed source hour

2_patterns.user_decision: Аналитик: какие часы и дни объясняют нагрузку, сравнимо между сезонами
2_patterns.definition: METRICS §4 пики, отдельно departures и arrivals; знаменатель — наблюдённые source hours
2_patterns.grain: hour of week; season x day type x hour; year x day type x hour

sql.hour_of_week:
SELECT isodow(lt)-1 weekday,hour(lt) local_hour,
        count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0) source_hours,sum(n)::BIGINT rides,
        sum(departures)::BIGINT departures,sum(arrivals)::BIGINT arrivals,
        sum(n)/nullif(count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0),0) rides_per_hour
        FROM hourly GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
sql.seasonal:
WITH h AS (SELECT lt::DATE m,lt,hour_utc,n,departures,arrivals
        FROM hourly)
        SELECT CASE WHEN month(m) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'winter'
    WHEN month(m) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'spring' WHEN month(m) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'summer'
    ELSE 'autumn' END season,CASE WHEN isodow(lt)>=6 THEN 'weekend'
            ELSE 'weekday' END day_type,hour(lt) local_hour,
        sum(n)/nullif(count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0),0) rides_per_hour,
        sum(departures)/nullif(count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0),0)
            departures_per_hour,
        sum(arrivals)/nullif(count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0),0)
            arrivals_per_hour
        FROM h GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
sql.by_year:
SELECT CASE WHEN lt<DATE '2025-10-01' THEN '2024-10..2025-09'
            ELSE '2025-10..2026-09' END period,hour(lt) local_hour,
        CASE WHEN isodow(lt)>=6 THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END day_type,
        sum(n)/nullif(count(DISTINCT hour_utc) FILTER(WHERE n>0),0) rides_per_hour
        FROM hourly GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

2_patterns.limits: Rates divide by observed source hours; 54 unknown source hours are not zero. Repeated and missing DST local hours keep their real UTC hours

3_concentration.user_decision: Руководитель/аналитик: насколько спрос сосредоточен и как меняется состав
3_concentration.definition: Доля по METRICS §4: числитель и знаменатель после фильтра. Gini и HHI — описательные меры неравенства, не официальные KPI
3_concentration.grain: NY month over known station IDs with at least one event

sql.monthly:
WITH s AS (SELECT m,departures+arrivals e,
            row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY m
                ORDER BY departures+arrivals,station_id) r,
            count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY m) n,
            sum(departures+arrivals) OVER(PARTITION BY m) t
            FROM station_month WHERE departures+arrivals>0)
        SELECT strftime(m,'%Y-%m') AS "month",any_value(n) observed_ids,
        sum(e) FILTER(WHERE r>n-ceil(n*0.01))/any_value(t) top1pct_share,
        sum(e) FILTER(WHERE r>n-ceil(n*0.1))/any_value(t) top10pct_share,
        sum(e*e)/(any_value(t)*any_value(t)) hhi,
        (2*sum(r*e)/(any_value(n)*any_value(t)))-(any_value(n)+1.0)/any_value(n) gini
        FROM s GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
sql.churn:
WITH f AS (SELECT station_id,min(m) first_m,max(m) last_m,
            count(*) month_count FROM station_month
            WHERE departures+arrivals>0 GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT strftime(g,'%Y-%m') AS "month",
        (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE first_m=g) entered,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE last_m=g) last_seen
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m g FROM station_month) ORDER BY g
sql.continuity:
WITH f AS (SELECT station_id,count(DISTINCT m) month_count
            FROM station_month WHERE departures+arrivals>0 GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT count(*) observed_ids,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE month_count=24) all_24_months,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE month_count<12) under_12_months FROM f

3_concentration.limits: Observed IDs with a trip are not active_stations (METRICS §2). First observation of an ID does not prove a station opening; `last_seen` of the final months only marks the data end

4_imbalance.user_decision: Операционная команда (симулируемая): где устойчивы дисбалансы и потоки
4_imbalance.grain: station; pattern; station x modal peak hour; directed station pair

sql.station:
WITH s AS (SELECT station_id,sum(departures) d,sum(arrivals) a,
            count(*) month_count,
            count(*) FILTER(WHERE arrivals>departures) months_surplus,
            count(*) FILTER(WHERE arrivals<departures) months_deficit
            FROM station_month WHERE m>=DATE '2025-10-01' GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT station_id,d::BIGINT departures,a::BIGINT arrivals,
        (a-d)::BIGINT net_trip_flow,(a-d)/nullif(a+d,0) net_share,month_count,
        months_surplus,months_deficit FROM s WHERE month_count>=6
        ORDER BY abs(a-d) DESC,station_id LIMIT 40
sql.peak_patterns:
WITH h AS (SELECT station_id,timezone('America/New_York',hour_utc) lt,
            departures,arrivals FROM fact_station_hourly
            WHERE hour_utc>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 04:00:00+00'
            AND hour_utc<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 04:00:00+00'),
        w AS (SELECT station_id,
            sum(arrivals-departures) FILTER(WHERE hour(lt) IN (7,8,9)) am,
            sum(arrivals-departures) FILTER(WHERE hour(lt) IN (16,17,18,19)) pm,
            sum(departures+arrivals) e
            FROM h WHERE isodow(lt)<=5 GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT CASE WHEN am>0 AND pm<0 THEN 'morning_inflow_evening_outflow'
            WHEN am<0 AND pm>0 THEN 'morning_outflow_evening_inflow'
            WHEN am>=0 AND pm>=0 THEN 'inflow_both_peaks'
            ELSE 'outflow_both_peaks' END pattern,
        count(*) stations,sum(e)::BIGINT weekday_events,sum(am)::BIGINT am_net,
        sum(pm)::BIGINT pm_net FROM w WHERE am IS NOT NULL AND pm IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
sql.persistent_peaks:
WITH h AS (SELECT station_id,
            date_trunc('month',timezone('America/New_York',hour_utc)) m,
            isodow(timezone('America/New_York',hour_utc))-1 w,
            hour(timezone('America/New_York',hour_utc)) lh,
            sum(departures+arrivals) e FROM fact_station_hourly
            WHERE hour_utc>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 04:00:00+00'
            AND hour_utc<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 04:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4),
        top AS (SELECT * FROM h QUALIFY row_number() OVER(
            PARTITION BY station_id,m ORDER BY e DESC,w,lh)=1),
        modal AS (SELECT station_id,w,lh,count(*) month_count,sum(e)::BIGINT events
            FROM top GROUP BY 1,2,3)
        SELECT station_id,w weekday,lh local_hour,month_count months_as_peak,events
        FROM modal WHERE month_count>=9 ORDER BY month_count DESC,events DESC,station_id
        LIMIT 30
sql.routes:
WITH r AS (SELECT from_station a,to_station b,sum(n) n
            FROM route_monthly WHERE local_month>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND local_month<DATE '2026-10-01'
            GROUP BY 1,2)
        SELECT x.a from_station,x.b to_station,x.n::BIGINT route_volume,
        coalesce(y.n,0)::BIGINT reverse_volume,
        (x.n-coalesce(y.n,0))/(x.n+coalesce(y.n,0)) direction_asymmetry
        FROM r x LEFT JOIN r y ON x.a=y.b AND x.b=y.a WHERE x.a<>x.b
        ORDER BY x.n DESC,x.a,x.b LIMIT 40
sql.route_coverage:
SELECT sum(route_n)::BIGINT known_pairs,sum(n)::BIGINT rides,
        sum(route_n)/sum(n) route_coverage FROM trip_monthly
        WHERE local_month>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND local_month<DATE '2026-10-01'
sql.id_split:
WITH s AS (SELECT station_id,sum(departures) d,sum(arrivals) a
            FROM station_month GROUP BY 1)
        SELECT x.station_id short_id,t.station_id twin_id,x.d::BIGINT short_departures,
        x.a::BIGINT short_arrivals,t.d::BIGINT twin_departures,
        t.a::BIGINT twin_arrivals FROM s x JOIN s t ON t.station_id=x.station_id||'0'
        WHERE regexp_full_match(x.station_id,'\d{4}\.\d') ORDER BY x.a DESC

WITH g AS (SELECT range hour_utc FROM range(

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE joined AS WITH f AS (
            SELECT model,station_id,avg(abs(predicted-actual)) mae,
            avg(predicted-actual) bias,sum(abs(predicted-actual))
                /nullif(sum(actual),0) wape FROM predictions GROUP BY 1,2),
        n AS (SELECT station_id,sum(departures) d,sum(arrivals) a FROM station_month
            WHERE m>=DATE '2025-10-01' GROUP BY 1)

        FROM f JOIN n USING(station_id)

        SELECT corr(a,b) rho,count(*) n FROM r

assumptions: SCENARIO ONLY: Poisson attempts use published observed trip forecasts as means, not latent-demand estimates.
Independent station/hour/type counts; returns are exogenous, not linked to simulated rentals. Fleet is an open subsystem.
Uniform within-hour events or all departures/arrivals in the first half-hour; demand scales are assumptions, not fitted intervals.
No demand is modeled between as-of and the next complete forecast hour; lead-in hold may be optimistic.
GBFS operating flags and capacity remain fixed after as-of; disabled/unknown slots capacity-bikes-docks stay blocked.
GBFS TTL validates the INITIAL snapshot only, not future observations over the simulation horizon.
All transport departs at as-of; one direct loaded trip per vehicle, no fleet reuse, depot routing or operator cost claims.
Haversine/specified speed plus handling gives scenario travel times, not measured street routes.
Delivery wins exact-time ties, then station/type/sequence; undeliverable cargo remains on its vehicle to horizon end.
Optimizer is optimal only for L1 inventory-target + weighted movement-cost surrogate; simulated losses can worsen.
Risk is ever-empty/full fraction including initial state among assumed draws; Monte Carlo Wilson intervals are not calibration.
No field validation/operational uplift/economic saving claim; Seasonal Naive/unavailable F4 fallback retained.

8_f5_policies.limits: Simulation only. Scope 3/64 cohort stations at one recorded as-of, not citywide, not live risk, not a field effect or an economy claim
